stem:
Harsh holds two leaves. Leaf P has a thick middle vein with a net-like pattern of veins on both sides. Leaf Q has veins that run side by side along the leaf.

Which labelling is correct?

options.text: Leaf P shows reticulate venation; leaf Q shows parallel venation.
Leaf P shows parallel venation; leaf Q shows reticulate venation.
Both leaves show reticulate venation because both have veins.
Both leaves show parallel venation because both are green and flat.

teacher.key_rationale: Net-like veins around a middle vein are reticulate; parallel veins are parallel venation. Swapping those labels reverses the relationship; merely having veins or being green does not fix the venation type.
